import time import threading from datetime import datetime import webbrowser import os # 引入你原有的所有引擎（假設已經整合成類別） from lightning_engines import ( LightningEarthRiskValueAI, DeliveryRiskSimulator, ) class LightningDashboard: def __init__(self): self.earth_ai = LightningEarthRiskValueAI() self.delivery_sim = DeliveryRiskSimulator() self.html_path = "lightning_dashboard.html" def generate_html(self): """產生即時儀表板 HTML""" now = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") # 1. 價值排名 value_rows = "" for i, asset in enumerate(self.earth_ai.ranked_assets, 1): value_rows += f""" {i} {asset['name']} {asset['score']} """ # 2. 颱風動態（簡化，只取一個颱風為例，實際可迴圈） typhoon_cards = "" for t in self.earth_ai.typhoons: debris_items = "" for d in t.get("debris", []): debris_items += f"
  • {d['type']}: {d['fly_distance_km']}km ({d['impact_probability']}%)
    • " city_risks = "" for city, risk in t.get("city_risks", {}).items(): econ = risk * 1.5 # 簡化經濟損失 city_risks += f""" {city} {risk:.1f}% {econ:.1f} """ typhoon_cards += f"""

    🌀 {t['name']} → {t['target_name']}

    風速: {t['wind']} km/h | 距離: {t['dist_to_target']:.0f} km

    預計抵達: {t['eta']}

    🧱 雜物搬運

      {debris_items}

    🏙️ 城市風險與經濟損失

    {city_risks}
    城市風險經濟損失
    """ # 3. 外送風險 delivery_status = f"""

    🛵 台中西屯外送風險

    即時雨量: {self.delivery_sim.rain_level:.1f} mm

    烏雲密度: {self.delivery_sim.dark_cloud:.1f}%

    風險等級: {self.delivery_sim.risk_level:.1f}%

    司機供給: {self.delivery_sim.driver_supply:.0f}%

    訂單需求: {self.delivery_sim.order_demand:.0f}%

    加成狀態: {'🔥 動態加成' if self.delivery_sim.surge else '✅ 正常'}

    """ html = f""" Lightning Earth Dashboard

    ⚡ Lightning Earth Risk Value AI

    即時更新時間: {now}

    🏆 未來核心資產價值排名

    {value_rows}
    排名資產價值分數

    🌪️ 颱風即時戰情

    {typhoon_cards}
    {delivery_status}

    📡 系統狀態

    所有引擎運作中

    下一更新: 5 秒後

    """ with open(self.html_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write(html) return self.html_path def run_headless(self, refresh_interval=5): """背景不斷更新 HTML 檔案""" print("📊 儀表板開始生成，每 5 秒刷新 HTML...") while True: # 先跑一次模擬更新（這部分需要你的引擎提供最新數據） self.earth_ai.update(3) self.delivery_sim.update() self.generate_html() time.sleep(refresh_interval) if __name__ == "__main__": dashboard = LightningDashboard() # 產生第一次 HTML 並打開瀏覽器 path = dashboard.generate_html() webbrowser.open("file://" + os.path.abspath(path)) # 背景執行更新 threading.Thread(target=dashboard.run_headless, daemon=True).start() input("按 Enter 停止...")
